notes: Default per-tool Allow/Block list for QwenPaw (AgentX) approvals. Enforced by policy.py decide(). This is a REPO-side list: it is NOT QwenPaw's denied_tools in working/config.json (that list is the live hard block in the running guard) and it is NOT wired into the live guard yet — see features/approvals/README.md. To make a deny here live in QwenPaw today, add the same tool to denied_tools in working/config.json (or QWENPAW_TOOL_GUARD_DENIED_TOOLS). How to edit this file: move a tool name between auto / ask / deny, keep the JSON valid, and re-run python3 features/approvals/test_approvals.py. A tool not listed here falls back to the SMART severity rule (LOW auto, MEDIUM+ ask, CRITICAL deny). Example deny entry, NOT enabled by default: adding "execute_shell_command" to deny would make shell use impossible rather than approval-gated (see README.md).
